text:
Sam Patel: Uploading the pen-test evidence bundle for the Acme POC. Zipped assets + CSV mapping of findings attached to the thread. Sharing timeline proposal.

Jin Park: Got the bundle. Quick skim: 6 total findings, 2 critical (JWT replay + exposed S3 object), 2 high (outdated deps), 2 medium (info leaks). I'll triage the criticals first.

Priya Desai: Thanks. Legal & vendor risk need a remediation ETA and interim evidence for their binder. Can we get an interim handoff by EOW? :calendar:

Alex Gomez: We can rotate keys and patch S3 ACLs tomorrow. Dependabot upgrade for libfoo will take a dev day + QA. For JWT nonce fix, small change in auth service, should be one sprint ticket.

Sam Patel: Proposed owners: Alex -> S3/key rotation + PRs, Jin -> verification + rescan evidence, Sam -> customer comms and vendor binder. Target remediation milestones:
- Interim evidence upload: 2025-11-03
- Fixed criticals (prod config + key rotation): 2025-11-04
- Full dependency upgrades & regression tests: 2025-11-07

Priya Desai: 2025-11-03 interim is acceptable. Legal wants scan outputs + brief verification steps for inclusion in the SIG/CAIQ review.

Jin Park: I'll run an authenticated Nessus + open-source re-scan and attach raw outputs. Will also produce a short verification checklist. Steps I plan to run:
```
# run re-scan
./tools/scan_runner --profile authenticated --targets acme-prod
# verify JWT
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/health --header "x-jwt-nonce: 12345"
```

Sam Patel: Uploaded initial evidence bundle to secure GCS: https://gcs.redwood-internal/reports/acme-poc/1865432100-pt.zip (access restricted). Shared read-only link with vendor risk.

sec-bot: Automated mapping complete: SECURITY-4312 -> CVE-2024-3141 (JWT replay) [critical]; SECURITY-4313 -> CVE-2023-2010 (S3 object ACL) [critical]. Recommendations included in ticket descriptions.

Alex Gomez: Opened PRs:
- PR #2892: s3/bucket ACL patch + infra test
- PR #2893: auth-service nonce check + unit tests
Both set for review. I'll post links once CI passes.

Jin Park: After PR merge I'll re-run the authenticated scans and post the Nessus XML + CSV. Interim artifact naming: pt-interim-1865432100.xml, pt-interim-1865432100.csv

Priya Desai: Please make sure test evidence includes timestamps, PR numbers, and a short note confirming environment (staging vs prod). We need clear indicators for the vendor binder.

Sam Patel: Noted. I'll include a one-page remediation summary for vendor risk: owners, ETA, artifacts (scan+PR+screenshot of fixed ACL), and contact. Drafting now.

Alex Gomez: CI found one flaky test on PR #2893, investigating. Might delay nonce fix by a day if flaky persists.

Jin Park: Fine for a 1-day slip as long as interim evidence shows config changes + key rotation done. I'll mark verification priority: critical -> high.

Priya Desai: If there's any delay >48h flag me directly @Sam Patel so we can update vendor legal.

Sam Patel: FYI I've created the tracking JIRA: SECURITY-4312 (parent) with subtasks: SECURITY-4312-1 (S3), -2 (JWT), -3 (deps). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SECURITY-4312

sec-bot: JIRA mapping added. Remediation SLA: criticals -> 5 business days default. Auto-ticket set.

Jin Park: Interim scan uploaded: gs://gcs.redwood-internal/reports/acme-poc/pt-interim-1865432100.xml (sha256: a3f4...) and CSV. Will attach to JIRA shortly.

Alex Gomez: S3 ACL change deployed to prod-canary at 2025-11-02T18:20Z. Key rotation complete for service-account-prod at 2025-11-02T20:05Z. PR #2892 merged.

Jin Park: Re-scan results: CVE-2023-2010 (S3) -> not detected; CVE-2024-3141 (JWT) -> still present in prod (nonce header missing on one code path). Evidence attached as snippet in JIRA comment.

Sam Patel: Shared updated binder with Acme vendor risk: binder_v2_2025-11-03.pdf. Customer responded: "We need verification that JWT fix will be in prod by 11/04." (legal tag)

Alex Gomez: Pushed hotfix branch for the JWT path, PR #2901 opened. CI green locally, pending review. ETA merge & deploy: 2025-11-04 morning.

Priya Desai: Good. Once PR #2901 is merged please post smoke-test outputs and the retest scan.

Jin Park: Will re-run authenticated scans after deployment and post full Nessus XML + CSV. Also will add a short verification checklist for the vendor binder.

sec-bot: Post-deploy check scheduled. Will run quick endpoint test and report status to thread.

Sam Patel: Customer replied with partial approval pending final scans. Keeping cadence: daily updates until closed. Thanks team. :raised_hands:

Jin Park: Final post-deploy scan uploaded: gs://gcs.redwood-internal/reports/acme-poc/pt-final-1865432100.xml. Both criticals now show as remediated. Attached verification checklist and screenshots.

Alex Gomez: Deployed fixes contained in PR #2892 and #2901. Closing remediation subtasks, leaving dependency upgrades to a follow-up sprint.

Priya Desai: Vendor risk confirmed binder accepted. Thanks everyone — will file closure note in vendor portal.

Sam Patel: Closing loop here. Final artifacts attached to JIRA and vendor binder.
